'''Eric Demetric Dickerson''' (born September 2, 1960) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[running back]] for 11 seasons in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[SMU Mustangs football|SMU Mustangs]], earning [[unanimous All-American]] honors in 1982.  Dickerson was selected [[List of second overall NFL draft picks|second overall]] in the [[1983 NFL draft]] by the [[Los Angeles Rams]], and later played for the [[Indianapolis Colts]], [[Los Angeles Raiders]], and [[Atlanta Falcons]]. During his NFL career, he rushed for over 13,000 yards. He holds the NFL's single-season rushing record with 2,105 yards, set in 1984. Dickerson was inducted into the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]] in 1999 and, in 2019, was named to the [[National Football League 100th Anniversary All-Time Team|NFL 100th Anniversary All-Time Team]]. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest running backs of all time.<ref>{{cite web |last1=McVey |first1=Rob |date=April 16, 2022 |title=25 Greatest Running Backs in NFL History |url=https://athlonsports.com/nfl/25-greatest-running-backs-nfl-history |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220810013604/https://athlonsports.com/nfl/25-greatest-running-backs-nfl-history |archive-date=August 10, 2022 |access-date=August 10, 2022 |website=Athlon Sports |quote=At 6-foot-3, Dickerson was not your prototypical running back, but he was one of the most successful backs to ever tote the pigskin. No one in NFL history has rushed for more yards in a single season than Dickerson (2,105 in 1984). Dickerson ranks ninth on the all-time rushing list and won four rushing titles during his Hall of Fame career.}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Kenyon |first1=David |title=The Top 10 NFL Running Backs of All Time |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2797764-the-top-10-nfl-running-backs-of-all-time |website=Bleacher Report |access-date=August 10, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220810013606/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2797764-the-top-10-nfl-running-backs-of-all-time |archive-date=August 10, 2022 |date=October 3, 2018}}</ref> He wore prescription goggles throughout his career due to [[Near-sightedness|myopia]].
